boundaries.name: \Gamma_o
boundaries.description: outer pipe casing exchanging heat with the environment by convection and surface radiation

boundaries.name: \Gamma_i
boundaries.description: inner wall (tube wall) held at the saturated steam temperature; shape optimised

constants.name: R
constants.description: outer radius of the pipe cross-section

objective.name: J
objective.description: maximise heat rejected to the environment through the outer casing (minimising J maximises the rejected heat)

state_equation.description: non-linear heat conduction with penalty Robin inner wall and convection/radiation outer casing
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi \left( \nabla u \cdot \nabla \delta u \right) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_i} \operatorname{pen} u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} \varepsilon \sigma u^{4} \delta u \,ds_x
state_equation.weak_form_rhs: \int_{\Gamma_i} \operatorname{pen} u_{H} \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h u_{amb} \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} \varepsilon \sigma u_{amb}^{4} \delta u \,ds_x

boundaries.rationale: Label 3 assigned by reconciliation with mesh labels and extracted optimization_params fixed_labels (fixed). Physical kind, design role and description preserved from extracted spec.

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: Extracted field; Dirichlet label reconciled to mesh label 2 for Gamma_i.

constants.name: R
constants.description: outer radius of the pipe cross-section

expressions.name: k
expressions.rationale: Effective thermal conductivity for the level-set topology optimization: solid aluminium where chi=1 and air where chi=0.

optimization_config.rationale: Designed from extracted optimization_params and physical dimensions: domain radius ~0.5 m, so hmax=0.05, hmin=0.005; standard level-set diffusion and velocity; initial level set as signed distance to initial inner radius r_0. Design/fixed boundary roles preserved from extracted optimization_params.
